description: Transnational health surveillance, Global Burden of Disease (GBD/DALY) computation, pandemic importation modeling, UHC assessment, and planetary health analytics.

inputs.name: demographics_payload
inputs.description: Country population, age structure, and baseline life expectancy

inputs.name: disease_burden_records
inputs.description: Cause-specific incident cases, deaths, and disability weights

inputs.name: health_capacity_metrics
inputs.description: Workforce density, critical care beds, cold chain, and financing

inputs.name: transboundary_mobility_matrix
inputs.description: Cross-border passenger volume and travel hazard links

inputs.name: climate_health_covariates
inputs.description: Environmental temperature anomalies, humidity, precipitation, and vector data

inputs.name: one_health_surveillance_signals
inputs.description: Zoonotic pathogen discoveries, wildlife trade exposure, and AMR isolates

outputs.name: daly_burden_analysis
outputs.description: Calculated YLL, YLD, total DALYs, and age-standardized burden rates

outputs.name: uhc_index_evaluation
outputs.description: Essential health service index and catastrophic expenditure score

outputs.name: importation_hazard_assessment
outputs.description: Border hazard score and epidemic arrival time probability distribution

outputs.name: equitable_resource_allocation
outputs.description: Optimized allocation of medical countermeasures across sovereign states

outputs.name: vector_borne_climate_risk
outputs.description: Arbovirus and malaria vectorial capacity shifts under climate anomalies

outputs.name: global_health_alerts
outputs.description: IHR early warning alerts and high-priority One Health notifications

capabilities: Planetary Health & Climate Vector Suitability Simulation
